item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00169","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C02","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 is explicitly identified in the child as the March 13, 1948 memorandum governing loyalty-record confidentiality, and the child closely reuses its distinctive justification, operative confidentiality rule, treatment of outside requests, and presidential-approval exception. The child adapts and expands that framework by specifying limited categories of permissible replies. C02 and C03 also anticipate the child's arguments against congressional disclosure, but they are less foundational and less closely matched to its operative machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the efficient and just administration of the Employee Loyalty Program requires that reports, records, files and investigative data relative to the program be preserved in strict confidence","parent_excerpt":"The efficient and just administration of the Employee Loyalty Program ... requires that reports, records, and files relative to the program be preserved in strict confidence.","explanation":"Near-verbatim reuse of the memorandum's central confidentiality rule and rationale."},{"child_excerpt":"That is necessary in the interest of our national security, to preserve the confidential character and sources of information, to protect Government personnel against the dissemination of unfounded or disproved allegations, and to insure the fair and just disposition of loyalty cases.","parent_excerpt":"This is necessary in the interest of our national security and welfare, to preserve the confidential character and sources of information furnished, and to protect Government personnel against the dissemination of unfounded or disproved allegations. It is necessary also in order to insure the fair and just disposition of loyalty cases.","explanation":"The child reproduces the parent's distinctive four-part justification with only minor compression."},{"child_excerpt":"no information regarding individual loyalty or security cases shall be provided in response to inquiries from outside the Executive branch unless such inquiries are made in writing","parent_excerpt":"Any subpena or demand or request for information ... received from sources other than those persons in the executive branch ... shall be respectfully declined","explanation":"The child adapts the parent's outside-Executive-Branch nondisclosure machinery into a more detailed written-inquiry policy."},{"child_excerpt":"No exceptions shall be made ... unless the agency head determines that it would be clearly in the public interest ... the requested information shall be released only after obtaining the approval of my office.","parent_excerpt":"There shall be no relaxation of the provisions of this directive except with my express authority.","explanation":"Both reserve exceptions to presidential approval, with the child adding an agency-head public-interest finding."}]}
